mapper.select: select p.p_id pId from p_privilege p inner join p_privilege_rel ppr on ppr.p_id = p.p_id and ppr.status_cd = '0' inner join p_privilege_group ppg on ppg.pg_id = ppr.pg_id and ppg.status_cd = '0' inner join p_privilege_user ppu on ppu.p_id = ppg.pg_id and ppu.privilege_flag = '1' and ppu.status_cd = '0' where p.status_cd = '0' and ppu.user_id = #{userId} and p.domain in (#{domain}, '9999') union select p.p_id pId from p_privilege p inner join p_privilege_user ppu on ppu.p_id = p.p_id and ppu.privilege_flag = '0' and ppu.status_cd = '0' where p.status_cd = '0' and ppu.user_id = #{userId} and p.domain in (#{domain}, '9999')
